The {{n_checks_word}} checks

{{n_probe_checks_cap}} probe checks fit one sequence feature against the class labels and report how well it separates them. {{n_integrity_checks_cap}} integrity checks count duplicates and unique bases. Together those {{n_split_checks_word}} run per split. The last, the leakage scan, runs across pairs of splits.

Each returns one of {{n_flags_word}} flags. Pass, Warning and Fail are scored outcomes. Unknown is not a fourth degree of severity: the check ran and could not be scored, which is a different statement from any of the {{n_scored_flags_word}} — and different again from a blank, which means the check had nothing to run on.
